narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On March 21, 2024, at approximately 1730 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] responded to a request for assistance from the Battle Creek Police Department regarding two men involved in a minor dispute at an apartment complex. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Honduras and that he has no documents to be in the United States. He presented a Honduran identity card.
The subject's cousin, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], who lives in the same apartment and is a lawful permanent resident, told Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] that he was deported to Honduras in 2014 and came back the following year.
Fingerprint checks of the subject returned no prior immigration history.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he entered without inspection near Hidalgo, Texas, in 2016.
TRAVEL:
He travelled to Michigan by bus.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear.
